gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically diagnosed as primary/relapsed/metastasized brain glioma;
This study is to investigate the safety and efficacy of tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy in patients with malignant glioma .

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes (TIL): Adoptive transfer of 1x10\^9-5x10\^10 autologous TILs to patients i.v. in 30-120 minutes.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Test subjects have failed standard treatment regimens, or there are no standard treatment regimens available.

role_evidence.quote: 1x10\^9-5x10\^10 in vitro expanded autologous TILs will be infused i.v. to patients with brain glioma after NMA lymphodepletion treatment with hydroxychloroquine(600mg,single-dose) and cyclophosphamide.

agents.drug_class_hint: GC101 TIL, autologous tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte cell therapy

role_evidence.quote: Autologous TILs are expanded from tumor resections and infused i.v. into the patient after NMA lymphodepletion treatment with hydroxychloroquine(600mg,single-dose) and cyclophosphamide.
Autologous TILs are expanded from tumor resections and infused i.v. into the patient after NMA lymphodepletion treatment with hydroxychloroquine(600mg,single-dose) and cyclophosphamide.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 record. Glioblastoma is not named anywhere (conditions 'Glioma'; 'malignant glioma'/'brain glioma'), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified -> not_glioblastoma. Intervention is TIL cell therapy (excluded type). Hydroxychloroquine and cyclophosphamide are given as non-myeloablative lymphodepletion before TIL, coded supportive (R6); hydroxychloroquine as a lymphodepleting agent is unusual but that is what the record states. Inclusion allows primary/relapsed disease but requires failure of standard treatment, so coded recurrent.
